class.name: LocalizedFont
class.brief_description: A font variation of a different font per locale.
class.description: A [FontVariation] of a different font for each locale, such as a font with the glyph shapes of Japanese. It can be used wherever a [Font] is, like the default font of a [Theme], and the text using it is drawn with the font of the new locale when the locale changes. The variation settings apply to the font of every locale. The resource of the locale is chosen like translations: the one of the current locale, or else of its language (for example [code]pt[/code] for [code]pt_BR[/code]), or else of the [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/fallback] locale, or else the default one. In the editor, the preview locale is used, or else the fallback locale. It changes when [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed] is emitted. If no font matches the locale and [member default_font] is not set, the default font of the theme is used. [b]Note:[/b] The fonts of all the locales are loaded with this resource and stay in memory, so the locale can change at once. For large resources, such as fonts with many glyphs, the remaps of the localization settings of the project load only the resource of the current locale, when the scene using it is loaded.

method.name: get_current_font
method.description: Returns the font used for the current locale.

members.member: The font used when no font of [member fonts] matches the locale.
The font of each locale, the keys being locale codes such as [code]en[/code] or [code]ja[/code].
